# Command-line reference

<!-- generated by scripts/build_docs.py, do not edit by hand -->

All subcommands are run as `mags-visualization <subcommand> [options]`. Defaults are shown in brackets. See [plots.md](plots.md) for an example of every plot.

```text
usage: mags-visualization [-h] [-v]
                          {sample-heatmap,drep-cluster-annot,drep-cluster-func,pathway-module-heatmap,comp-conta,taxa-sankey,overview-figure,all}
                          ...

Visualize and analyse MAGs (Metagenome-Assembled Genomes).

positional arguments:
  {sample-heatmap,drep-cluster-annot,drep-cluster-func,pathway-module-heatmap,comp-conta,taxa-sankey,overview-figure,all}
    sample-heatmap      Create the sample heatmap plot.
    drep-cluster-annot  Create the dRep cluster plot.
    drep-cluster-func   Create the dRep cluster plot with functional
                        annotation.
    pathway-module-heatmap
                        Create a MAG vs pathway-module heatmap grouped by
                        pathway_class.
    comp-conta          Create completeness/contamination plots.
    taxa-sankey         Create GTDB taxa sankey plots.
    overview-figure     Page-width multi-panel overview figure (abundance,
                        quality, taxonomy, function).
    all                 Run all plots (legacy behaviour).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -v, -V, --version     show program's version number and exit
```

## sample-heatmap

```text
usage: mags-visualization sample-heatmap [-h] --coverm COVERM_PATH --gtdb
                                         GTDB_FILE [--metadata METADATA_FILE]
                                         [--meta_cols META_COLS [META_COLS ...]]
                                         [--tax_level {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}]
                                         -o OUTPUT [--format {png,pdf,svg}]
                                         [--meta_bin_width META_BIN_WIDTH]
                                         [--max_col MAX_COL] [--no_log]
                                         [--top_bar_height TOP_BAR_HEIGHT]
                                         [--hspace HSPACE]
                                         [--heatmap_width HEATMAP_WIDTH]
                                         [--spacer_legend SPACER_LEGEND]
                                         [--spacer_meta SPACER_META]
                                         [--spacer_heatmap SPACER_HEATMAP]
                                         [--legend LEGEND]
                                         [--meta_bar_add META_BAR_ADD]
                                         [--top_bar_spacer TOP_BAR_SPACER]
                                         [--style {classic,overview}]
                                         [--width_cm WIDTH_CM]
                                         [--font_size FONT_SIZE]
                                         [--color_rank {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}]
                                         [--dpi DPI]
                                         [--meta_labels META_LABELS [META_LABELS ...]]
                                         [--sample_label_col SAMPLE_LABEL_COL]
                                         [--sample_group_col SAMPLE_GROUP_COL]
                                         [--group_order GROUP_ORDER [GROUP_ORDER ...]]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --coverm COVERM_PATH  CoverM relative abundance table (genomes x samples,
                        incl. 'unmapped'), or a folder of tables (default:
                        None)
  --gtdb GTDB_FILE      GTDB-Tk summary table (user_genome, classification,
                        ...) (default: None)
  --metadata METADATA_FILE
                        Sample metadata table; the first column holds the
                        sample names used in the CoverM columns (default:
                        None)
  --meta_cols META_COLS [META_COLS ...]
                        Metadata columns shown as annotation bars (names or
                        1-based column indices) (default: None)
  --tax_level {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}
                        GTDB rank used to group and colour the MAGs (default:
                        phylum)
  -o OUTPUT, --output OUTPUT
                        Output folder (created if it does not exist) (default:
                        None)
  --format {png,pdf,svg}
                        Output file format (default: png)
  --meta_bin_width META_BIN_WIDTH
                        Bin width used to group numeric metadata values
                        (default: 5.0)
  --max_col MAX_COL     Show the N most abundant taxa as columns and pool the
                        rest as 'Others' (default: 10)
  --no_log              Plot MAGs per taxon on a linear instead of a log10
                        axis (default: False)
  --style {classic,overview}
                        Plot style: 'classic' is the original plot, 'overview'
                        draws the matching panel of overview-figure at print
                        size (--width_cm, --font_size) with its options below
                        (default: classic)

Heatmap Layout Options (all values in cm):
  --top_bar_height TOP_BAR_HEIGHT
                        Height of the MAGs-per-taxon bar chart (default: 1.8)
  --hspace HSPACE       Vertical gap between the bar chart and the heatmap
                        (default: 0.6)
  --heatmap_width HEATMAP_WIDTH
                        Width of the heatmap (default: 28.0)
  --spacer_legend SPACER_LEGEND
                        Gap between the legend and the metadata bars (default:
                        0.8)
  --spacer_meta SPACER_META
                        Gap between the metadata bars and the heatmap
                        (default: 5.0)
  --spacer_heatmap SPACER_HEATMAP
                        Gap between the heatmap and the MAGs-per-sample
                        histogram (default: 0.25)
  --legend LEGEND       Width of the legend column (default: 6.4)
  --meta_bar_add META_BAR_ADD
                        Extra width added to the metadata bars (default: 3.8)
  --top_bar_spacer TOP_BAR_SPACER
                        Gap above the MAGs-per-taxon bar chart (default: 0.0)

overview style (--style overview):
  --width_cm WIDTH_CM   Figure width in cm at print size (17 = full page
                        width, 8.5 = one column) (default: 12.0)
  --font_size FONT_SIZE
                        Base font size in pt at print size; dense labels use
                        85% of it (default: 8.0)
  --color_rank {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}
                        Rank whose taxa get one colour each (shared by all
                        panels) (default: phylum)
  --dpi DPI             Resolution of PNG output (default: 300)
  --meta_labels META_LABELS [META_LABELS ...]
                        Display names for --meta_cols (same order) (default:
                        None)
  --sample_label_col SAMPLE_LABEL_COL
                        Metadata column used as sample label (name or 1-based
                        index) (default: None)
  --sample_group_col SAMPLE_GROUP_COL
                        Metadata column grouping the samples (sorted together,
                        separated by a gap); name or 1-based index (default:
                        None)
  --group_order GROUP_ORDER [GROUP_ORDER ...]
                        Order of the sample groups (default: None)
```

## drep-cluster-annot

```text
usage: mags-visualization drep-cluster-annot [-h] --drep DREP_FILE --gtdb
                                             GTDB_FILE
                                             [--checkm2 CHECKM2_FILE]
                                             [--quast QUAST_FILE]
                                             [--bakta BAKTA_FILE]
                                             [--tax_levels {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species} [{domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species} ...]]
                                             [--top_n N]
                                             [--tax_levels_space TAX_LEVELS_SPACE]
                                             [--fig_size WIDTH HEIGHT]
                                             [--require_quality] -o OUTPUT
                                             [--format {png,pdf,svg}]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --drep DREP_FILE      dRep cluster table Cdb.csv (genome, secondary_cluster,
                        ...) (default: None)
  --gtdb GTDB_FILE      GTDB-Tk summary table (user_genome, classification,
                        ...) (default: None)
  --checkm2 CHECKM2_FILE
                        CheckM2 quality report (Name, Completeness,
                        Contamination, ...) (default: None)
  --quast QUAST_FILE    QUAST report with one column per MAG (default: None)
  --bakta BAKTA_FILE    Bakta summary with one column per MAG (default: None)
  --tax_levels {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species} [{domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species} ...]
                        GTDB ranks shown as taxonomy columns next to the
                        clusters (default: ['phylum', 'genus'])
  --top_n N             Number of largest dRep clusters (or most frequent
                        categories) shown; minimum 5 (default: 30)
  --tax_levels_space TAX_LEVELS_SPACE
                        Spacing between taxonomy columns (cm) (default: 0.8)
  --fig_size WIDTH HEIGHT
                        Figure size in cm (width height) (default: None)
  --require_quality     Only show clusters whose representative has CheckM2
                        data (default: False)
  -o OUTPUT, --output OUTPUT
                        Output folder (created if it does not exist) (default:
                        None)
  --format {png,pdf,svg}
                        Output file format (default: png)
```

## drep-cluster-func

```text
usage: mags-visualization drep-cluster-func [-h] --drep DREP_FILE --gtdb
                                            GTDB_FILE [--checkm2 CHECKM2_FILE]
                                            [--quast QUAST_FILE]
                                            [--bakta BAKTA_FILE]
                                            [--pathways PATHWAYS_FILE]
                                            [--tax_levels {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species} [{domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species} ...]]
                                            [--top_n N]
                                            [--tax_levels_space TAX_LEVELS_SPACE]
                                            [--fig_size WIDTH HEIGHT] -o
                                            OUTPUT [--format {png,pdf,svg}]
                                            [--top_modules TOP_MODULES]
                                            [--mode {mean,variance,both}]
                                            [--module_label {id,name,both}]
                                            [--style {classic,overview}]
                                            [--width_cm WIDTH_CM]
                                            [--font_size FONT_SIZE]
                                            [--color_rank {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}]
                                            [--dpi DPI]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --drep DREP_FILE      dRep cluster table Cdb.csv (genome, secondary_cluster,
                        ...) (default: None)
  --gtdb GTDB_FILE      GTDB-Tk summary table (user_genome, classification,
                        ...) (default: None)
  --checkm2 CHECKM2_FILE
                        CheckM2 quality report (Name, Completeness,
                        Contamination, ...) (default: None)
  --quast QUAST_FILE    QUAST report with one column per MAG (default: None)
  --bakta BAKTA_FILE    Bakta summary with one column per MAG (default: None)
  --pathways PATHWAYS_FILE
                        TSV with contig, module accession, completeness,
                        pathway_name, pathway_class, ... (default: None)
  --tax_levels {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species} [{domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species} ...]
                        GTDB ranks shown as taxonomy columns next to the
                        clusters (default: ['phylum', 'genus'])
  --top_n N             Number of largest dRep clusters (or most frequent
                        categories) shown; minimum 5 (default: 30)
  --tax_levels_space TAX_LEVELS_SPACE
                        Spacing between taxonomy columns (cm) (default: 0.8)
  --fig_size WIDTH HEIGHT
                        Figure size in cm (width height) (default: None)
  -o OUTPUT, --output OUTPUT
                        Output folder (created if it does not exist) (default:
                        None)
  --format {png,pdf,svg}
                        Output file format (default: png)
  --top_modules TOP_MODULES
                        Number of KEGG modules shown ('none' for all)
                        (default: 35)
  --mode {mean,variance,both}
                        mean = core modules, variance = differential modules,
                        or both. (default: mean)
  --module_label {id,name,both}
                        Module labels on the x-axis: id, name or both
                        (default: id)
  --style {classic,overview}
                        Plot style: 'classic' is the original plot, 'overview'
                        draws the matching panel of overview-figure at print
                        size (--width_cm, --font_size) with its options below
                        (default: classic)

overview style (--style overview):
  --width_cm WIDTH_CM   Figure width in cm at print size (17 = full page
                        width, 8.5 = one column) (default: 17.0)
  --font_size FONT_SIZE
                        Base font size in pt at print size; dense labels use
                        85% of it (default: 8.0)
  --color_rank {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}
                        Rank whose taxa get one colour each (shared by all
                        panels) (default: phylum)
  --dpi DPI             Resolution of PNG output (default: 300)
```

## pathway-module-heatmap

```text
usage: mags-visualization pathway-module-heatmap [-h] --pathways PATHWAYS_FILE
                                                 [--top_modules TOP_MODULES]
                                                 [--mode {mean,variance}]
                                                 [--fig_size WIDTH HEIGHT]
                                                 [--row_fontsize ROW_FONTSIZE]
                                                 -o OUTPUT
                                                 [--format {png,pdf,svg}]
                                                 [--drep DREP_FILE]
                                                 [--gtdb GTDB_FILE]
                                                 [--top_representatives TOP_REPRESENTATIVES]
                                                 [--sort_by {cluster_size,none}]
                                                 [--module_label {id,name,both}]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --pathways PATHWAYS_FILE
                        TSV with contig, module_accession, completeness,
                        pathway_name, pathway_class, ... (default: None)
  --top_modules TOP_MODULES
                        Number of modules to show. Use None to show all
                        modules. (default: 30)
  --mode {mean,variance}
                        mean = core modules, variance = differential modules
                        (default: mean)
  --fig_size WIDTH HEIGHT
                        Figure size in cm (width height) (default: None)
  --row_fontsize ROW_FONTSIZE
                        Font size (pt) of the MAG names on the rows (default:
                        8)
  -o OUTPUT, --output OUTPUT
                        Output folder (created if it does not exist) (default:
                        None)
  --format {png,pdf,svg}
                        Output file format (default: png)
  --drep DREP_FILE      Optional dRep table used to restrict the heatmap to
                        representatives only. (default: None)
  --gtdb GTDB_FILE      Optional GTDB table required together with --drep when
                        using --top_representatives. (default: None)
  --top_representatives TOP_REPRESENTATIVES
                        Limit number of representative MAGs (e.g. top 30)
                        (default: None)
  --sort_by {cluster_size,none}
                        How to select top representatives (default:
                        cluster_size)
  --module_label {id,name,both}
                        Module labels on the x-axis: id, name, or both.
                        (default: id)
```

## comp-conta

```text
usage: mags-visualization comp-conta [-h] [--tools {both,checkm,checkm2}]
                                     [--checkm CHECKM_FILE]
                                     [--checkm2 CHECKM2_FILE]
                                     [--gtdb GTDB_FILE]
                                     [--metadata METADATA_FILE]
                                     [--meta_col META_COL]
                                     [--meta_bin_width META_BIN_WIDTH]
                                     [--top_n N] [--mode {quality,tax,meta}]
                                     [--tax_level {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}]
                                     [--fig_size WIDTH HEIGHT] -o OUTPUT
                                     [--format {png,pdf,svg}]
                                     [--style {classic,overview}]
                                     [--width_cm WIDTH_CM]
                                     [--font_size FONT_SIZE]
                                     [--color_rank {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}]
                                     [--dpi DPI]
                                     [--hq_completeness HQ_COMPLETENESS]
                                     [--hq_contamination HQ_CONTAMINATION]
                                     [--mq_completeness MQ_COMPLETENESS]
                                     [--mq_contamination MQ_CONTAMINATION]
                                     [--max_contamination_axis MAX_CONTAMINATION_AXIS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --tools {both,checkm,checkm2}
                        Which tool results to plot (default: both) (default:
                        both)
  --checkm CHECKM_FILE  CheckM quality table (Bin Id, Completeness,
                        Contamination, ...) (default: None)
  --checkm2 CHECKM2_FILE
                        CheckM2 quality report (Name, Completeness,
                        Contamination, ...) (default: None)
  --gtdb GTDB_FILE      GTDB-Tk summary table (user_genome, classification,
                        ...) (default: None)
  --metadata METADATA_FILE
                        Sample metadata table; the first column holds the
                        sample names used in the CoverM columns (default:
                        None)
  --meta_col META_COL   Metadata column used for colouring (name or 1-based
                        column index) (default: None)
  --meta_bin_width META_BIN_WIDTH
                        Bin width used to group numeric metadata values
                        (default: 5.0)
  --top_n N             Number of largest dRep clusters (or most frequent
                        categories) shown; minimum 5 (default: 30)
  --mode {quality,tax,meta}
                        quality = plain plots; tax = rank plot needs --gtdb;
                        meta = metadata plot needs --metadata and --meta_col
                        (default: quality)
  --tax_level {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}
                        GTDB rank used to group and colour the MAGs (default:
                        phylum)
  --fig_size WIDTH HEIGHT
                        Figure size in cm (width height) (default: None)
  -o OUTPUT, --output OUTPUT
                        Output folder (created if it does not exist) (default:
                        None)
  --format {png,pdf,svg}
                        Output file format (default: png)
  --style {classic,overview}
                        Plot style: 'classic' is the original plot, 'overview'
                        draws the matching panel of overview-figure at print
                        size (--width_cm, --font_size) with its options below
                        (default: classic)

overview style (--style overview, --mode quality only):
  --width_cm WIDTH_CM   Figure width in cm at print size (17 = full page
                        width, 8.5 = one column) (default: 8.5)
  --font_size FONT_SIZE
                        Base font size in pt at print size; dense labels use
                        85% of it (default: 7.0)
  --color_rank {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}
                        Rank whose taxa get one colour each (shared by all
                        panels) (default: phylum)
  --dpi DPI             Resolution of PNG output (default: 300)
  --hq_completeness HQ_COMPLETENESS
                        Minimum completeness of high-quality MAGs (default:
                        90.0)
  --hq_contamination HQ_CONTAMINATION
                        Maximum contamination of high-quality MAGs (default:
                        5.0)
  --mq_completeness MQ_COMPLETENESS
                        Minimum completeness of medium-quality MAGs (default:
                        70.0)
  --mq_contamination MQ_CONTAMINATION
                        Maximum contamination of medium-quality MAGs (no limit
                        if unset) (default: None)
  --max_contamination_axis MAX_CONTAMINATION_AXIS
                        Upper limit of the contamination axis; MAGs above it
                        are drawn as triangles at the edge and their values
                        listed in the legend (default: 8.0)
```

## taxa-sankey

```text
usage: mags-visualization taxa-sankey [-h] --gtdb GTDB_FILE
                                      [--coverm COVERM_PATH]
                                      [--rank {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}]
                                      [--font_size FONT_SIZE] [--order_links]
                                      [--format {html,png,pdf,svg}] -o OUTPUT
                                      [--style {classic,overview}]
                                      [--width_cm WIDTH_CM]
                                      [--color_rank {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}]
                                      [--dpi DPI] [--flow_ranks FROM TO]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --gtdb GTDB_FILE      GTDB-Tk summary table (user_genome, classification,
                        ...) (default: None)
  --coverm COVERM_PATH  Optional CoverM abundance table; bar sizes become
                        abundance-based (default: None)
  --rank {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}
                        Rank of the second Sankey diagram
                        (sankey_plot_rank_filtered), which links each MAG to
                        its taxon at this rank (default: phylum)
  --font_size FONT_SIZE
                        Font size of the labels: px in the classic Plotly plot
                        (default 10), pt in the overview style (default 8)
                        (default: None)
  --order_links         Order nodes/links to reduce crossings (writes
                        sankey_plot_ordered.*) (default: False)
  --format {html,png,pdf,svg}
                        Output file format (default: html)
  -o OUTPUT, --output OUTPUT
                        Output folder (created if it does not exist) (default:
                        None)
  --style {classic,overview}
                        Plot style: 'classic' is the original plot, 'overview'
                        draws the matching panel of overview-figure at print
                        size (--width_cm, --font_size) with its options below
                        (default: classic)

overview style (--style overview; png, pdf or svg):
  --width_cm WIDTH_CM   Figure width in cm at print size (17 = full page
                        width, 8.5 = one column) (default: 17.0)
  --color_rank {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}
                        Rank whose taxa get one colour each (shared by all
                        panels) (default: phylum)
  --dpi DPI             Resolution of PNG output (default: 300)
  --flow_ranks FROM TO  First and last rank of the flow diagram (default:
                        ['phylum', 'genus'])
```

## overview-figure

```text
usage: mags-visualization overview-figure [-h] --gtdb GTDB_FILE
                                          [--coverm COVERM_PATH]
                                          [--checkm2 CHECKM2_FILE]
                                          [--checkm CHECKM_FILE]
                                          [--drep DREP_FILE]
                                          [--pathways PATHWAYS_FILE]
                                          [--metadata METADATA_FILE]
                                          [--panels {abundance,quality,taxonomy,function} [{abundance,quality,taxonomy,function} ...]]
                                          [--width_cm WIDTH_CM]
                                          [--font_size FONT_SIZE]
                                          [--color_rank {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}]
                                          [--dpi DPI]
                                          [--tax_level {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}]
                                          [--max_taxa MAX_TAXA]
                                          [--meta_cols META_COLS [META_COLS ...]]
                                          [--meta_labels META_LABELS [META_LABELS ...]]
                                          [--sample_label_col SAMPLE_LABEL_COL]
                                          [--sample_group_col SAMPLE_GROUP_COL]
                                          [--group_order GROUP_ORDER [GROUP_ORDER ...]]
                                          [--hq_completeness HQ_COMPLETENESS]
                                          [--hq_contamination HQ_CONTAMINATION]
                                          [--mq_completeness MQ_COMPLETENESS]
                                          [--mq_contamination MQ_CONTAMINATION]
                                          [--max_contamination_axis MAX_CONTAMINATION_AXIS]
                                          [--flow_ranks FROM TO]
                                          [--top_n TOP_N]
                                          [--top_modules TOP_MODULES]
                                          [--module_mode {mean,variance}]
                                          [--format {png,pdf,svg} [{png,pdf,svg} ...]]
                                          [--prefix PREFIX] -o OUTPUT

Draw a publication-ready overview of a MAG catalogue at its final print size.
Panels: abundance (relative abundance per sample and taxon, with sample
metadata), quality (completeness vs contamination), taxonomy (flow diagram
between two ranks) and function (largest dRep clusters with KEGG module
completeness). Panels whose inputs are missing are skipped; use --panels to
draw a subset or a single panel.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

inputs:
  --gtdb GTDB_FILE      GTDB-Tk summary table (all panels) (default: None)
  --coverm COVERM_PATH  CoverM relative abundance table, or a folder of tables
                        (abundance panel) (default: None)
  --checkm2 CHECKM2_FILE
                        CheckM2 quality report (quality panel) (default: None)
  --checkm CHECKM_FILE  CheckM quality report, used for the quality panel if
                        no CheckM2 report is given (default: None)
  --drep DREP_FILE      dRep Cdb table (function panel) (default: None)
  --pathways PATHWAYS_FILE
                        KEGG pathway completeness table (function panel)
                        (default: None)
  --metadata METADATA_FILE
                        Sample metadata; the first column must hold the CoverM
                        sample names (abundance panel) (default: None)

layout:
  --panels {abundance,quality,taxonomy,function} [{abundance,quality,taxonomy,function} ...]
                        Panels to draw, in figure order (default:
                        ['abundance', 'quality', 'taxonomy', 'function'])
  --width_cm WIDTH_CM   Figure width in cm at print size (17 = full page
                        width, 8.5 = one column) (default: 17.0)
  --font_size FONT_SIZE
                        Base font size in pt at print size; dense labels use
                        85% of it (default: 8.0)
  --color_rank {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}
                        Rank whose taxa get one colour each (shared by all
                        panels) (default: phylum)
  --dpi DPI             Resolution of PNG output (default: 300)

abundance panel:
  --tax_level {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}
                        Rank of the heatmap rows (default: phylum)
  --max_taxa MAX_TAXA   Show the N most abundant taxa, pool the rest as Other
                        (default: 10)
  --meta_cols META_COLS [META_COLS ...]
                        Metadata columns shown as rows above the heatmap
                        (names or 1-based indices). Boolean columns become
                        filled/empty squares, others coloured squares
                        (default: None)
  --meta_labels META_LABELS [META_LABELS ...]
                        Display names for --meta_cols (same order) (default:
                        None)
  --sample_label_col SAMPLE_LABEL_COL
                        Metadata column used as sample label (name or 1-based
                        index) (default: None)
  --sample_group_col SAMPLE_GROUP_COL
                        Metadata column grouping the samples (sorted together,
                        separated by a gap); name or 1-based index (default:
                        None)
  --group_order GROUP_ORDER [GROUP_ORDER ...]
                        Order of the sample groups (default: None)

quality panel:
  --hq_completeness HQ_COMPLETENESS
                        Minimum completeness of high-quality MAGs (default:
                        90.0)
  --hq_contamination HQ_CONTAMINATION
                        Maximum contamination of high-quality MAGs (default:
                        5.0)
  --mq_completeness MQ_COMPLETENESS
                        Minimum completeness of medium-quality MAGs (default:
                        70.0)
  --mq_contamination MQ_CONTAMINATION
                        Maximum contamination of medium-quality MAGs (no limit
                        if unset) (default: None)
  --max_contamination_axis MAX_CONTAMINATION_AXIS
                        Upper limit of the contamination axis; MAGs above it
                        are drawn as triangles at the edge and their values
                        listed in the legend (default: 8.0)

taxonomy panel:
  --flow_ranks FROM TO  First and last rank of the flow diagram (default:
                        ['phylum', 'genus'])

function panel:
  --top_n TOP_N         Number of largest dRep clusters shown (default: 30)
  --top_modules TOP_MODULES
                        Number of KEGG modules shown (default: 35)
  --module_mode {mean,variance}
                        Select modules with the highest mean completeness
                        (core functions) or variance (differences between
                        clusters) (default: mean)

output:
  --format {png,pdf,svg} [{png,pdf,svg} ...]
                        One or more output formats (default: ['png'])
  --prefix PREFIX       File name (without extension) inside --output
                        (default: overview_figure)
  -o OUTPUT, --output OUTPUT
                        Output folder (default: None)
```

## all

```text
usage: mags-visualization all [-h] [--coverm COVERM_PATH]
                              [--checkm CHECKM_FILE] [--checkm2 CHECKM2_FILE]
                              [--gtdb GTDB_FILE] [--drep DREP_FILE]
                              [--quast QUAST_FILE] [--bakta BAKTA_FILE]
                              [--metadata METADATA_FILE]
                              [--pathways PATHWAYS_FILE]
                              [--rank {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}]
                              [--tax_level {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}]
                              [--tax_levels {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species} [{domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species} ...]]
                              [--top_n N] [--quality] [--require_quality]
                              [--tax] [--meta_col META_COL]
                              [--meta_cols META_COLS [META_COLS ...]]
                              [--meta_bin_width META_BIN_WIDTH]
                              [--column_choice METRIC [METRIC ...]]
                              [--color_by {quality,tax,meta}]
                              [--tax_levels_space TAX_LEVELS_SPACE]
                              [--fig_size WIDTH HEIGHT] -o OUTPUT
                              [--format {png,pdf,svg}]
                              [--top_bar_height TOP_BAR_HEIGHT]
                              [--hspace HSPACE]
                              [--heatmap_width HEATMAP_WIDTH]
                              [--spacer_legend SPACER_LEGEND]
                              [--spacer_meta SPACER_META]
                              [--spacer_heatmap SPACER_HEATMAP]
                              [--legend LEGEND] [--meta_bar_add META_BAR_ADD]
                              [--top_bar_spacer TOP_BAR_SPACER]
                              [--max_col MAX_COL] [--no_log]
                              [--top_modules TOP_MODULES]
                              [--mode {mean,variance}] [--show_module_labels]
                              [--row_fontsize ROW_FONTSIZE]
                              [--top_representatives TOP_REPRESENTATIVES]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --coverm COVERM_PATH  CoverM relative abundance table (genomes x samples,
                        incl. 'unmapped'), or a folder of tables (default:
                        None)
  --checkm CHECKM_FILE  CheckM quality table (Bin Id, Completeness,
                        Contamination, ...) (default: None)
  --checkm2 CHECKM2_FILE
                        CheckM2 quality report (Name, Completeness,
                        Contamination, ...) (default: None)
  --gtdb GTDB_FILE      GTDB-Tk summary table (user_genome, classification,
                        ...) (default: None)
  --drep DREP_FILE      dRep cluster table Cdb.csv (genome, secondary_cluster,
                        ...) (default: None)
  --quast QUAST_FILE    QUAST report with one column per MAG (default: None)
  --bakta BAKTA_FILE    Bakta summary with one column per MAG (default: None)
  --metadata METADATA_FILE
                        Sample metadata table; the first column holds the
                        sample names used in the CoverM columns (default:
                        None)
  --pathways PATHWAYS_FILE
                        KEGG pathway completeness table (contig,
                        module_accession, completeness, pathway_name,
                        pathway_class) (default: None)
  --rank {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}
                        Rank of the second Sankey diagram
                        (sankey_plot_rank_filtered), which links each MAG to
                        its taxon at this rank (default: phylum)
  --tax_level {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species}
                        GTDB rank used to group and colour the MAGs (default:
                        None)
  --tax_levels {domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species} [{domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species} ...]
                        GTDB ranks shown as taxonomy columns next to the
                        clusters (default: ['phylum', 'genus'])
  --top_n N             Number of largest dRep clusters (or most frequent
                        categories) shown; minimum 5 (default: 30)
  --quality             Colour the completeness/contamination plot by MAG
                        quality (default: False)
  --require_quality     Only show clusters whose representative has CheckM2
                        data (default: False)
  --tax                 Colour the completeness/contamination plot by taxonomy
                        (default: False)
  --meta_col META_COL   Metadata column used for colouring (name or 1-based
                        column index) (default: None)
  --meta_cols META_COLS [META_COLS ...]
                        Metadata columns shown as annotation bars (names or
                        1-based column indices) (default: None)
  --meta_bin_width META_BIN_WIDTH
                        Bin width used to group numeric metadata values
                        (default: 5.0)
  --column_choice METRIC [METRIC ...]
                        Unused; accepted for backwards compatibility (default:
                        None)
  --color_by {quality,tax,meta}
                        Colouring of the completeness/contamination plot
                        (default: None)
  --tax_levels_space TAX_LEVELS_SPACE
                        Spacing between taxonomy columns (cm) (default: 0.8)
  --fig_size WIDTH HEIGHT
                        Figure size in cm (width height) (default: None)
  -o OUTPUT, --output OUTPUT
                        Output folder (created if it does not exist) (default:
                        None)
  --format {png,pdf,svg}
                        Output file format (default: png)
  --top_bar_height TOP_BAR_HEIGHT
                        Height of the MAGs-per-taxon bar chart (default: 1.8)
  --hspace HSPACE       Vertical gap between the bar chart and the heatmap
                        (default: 0.6)
  --heatmap_width HEATMAP_WIDTH
                        Width of the heatmap (default: 28.0)
  --spacer_legend SPACER_LEGEND
                        Gap between the legend and the metadata bars (default:
                        0.8)
  --spacer_meta SPACER_META
                        Gap between the metadata bars and the heatmap
                        (default: 5.0)
  --spacer_heatmap SPACER_HEATMAP
                        Gap between the heatmap and the MAGs-per-sample
                        histogram (default: 0.25)
  --legend LEGEND       Width of the legend column (default: 6.4)
  --meta_bar_add META_BAR_ADD
                        Extra width added to the metadata bars (default: 3.8)
  --top_bar_spacer TOP_BAR_SPACER
                        Gap above the MAGs-per-taxon bar chart (default: 0.0)
  --max_col MAX_COL     Show the N most abundant taxa as columns and pool the
                        rest as 'Others' (default: 10)
  --no_log              Plot MAGs per taxon on a linear instead of a log10
                        axis (default: False)
  --top_modules TOP_MODULES
                        Number of KEGG modules shown ('none' for all)
                        (default: 35)
  --mode {mean,variance}
                        Module selection: mean = core modules, variance =
                        differential modules (default: mean)
  --show_module_labels  Unused; accepted for backwards compatibility (see
                        --module_label) (default: False)
  --row_fontsize ROW_FONTSIZE
                        Font size (pt) of the MAG names on the rows (default:
                        8)
  --top_representatives TOP_REPRESENTATIVES
                        Limit the heatmap to the representatives of the N
                        largest clusters (default: None)
```
